description: Record that two books are out with friends.
rationale: update_rows rather than backfill, because each row gets its OWN values and there is no expression to re-derive them from. That is also why assert_invariants is here: with per-row values there is no rule that says what the update should have done, so the check has to be stated. The pair constraint on house.book means borrowed_by and borrowed_on have to move together, which this does in one statement.

assert_invariants.name: borrow_pair_never_half_set
assert_invariants.query: SELECT count(*)::text FROM house.book WHERE (borrowed_by IS NULL) <> (borrowed_on IS NULL)
